name: shop.attribute.values/v1
description: The shop's door for a plugin's own field values (ATTRIBUTES.md): read them on an order, a line, a product or a customer, set one — a write command, keyed, kept with the plugin that wrote it, announced once committed — and take one back. A plugin reaches only its own fields: Core names the caller.

methods.name: values.get
methods.description: EXPERIMENTAL. The calling plugin's values on one record — on an order, its order and line values and the copies of its customer and product values taken when the order was placed.
methods.agent_reason: a plugin's value is set by the buyer at checkout, by the owner on the shop's screens and abilities, or by its own plugin through this door; an assistant writing here would write under no plugin's key

methods.name: value.set
methods.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Set one of the calling plugin's fields on one record, checked against its declaration; the same idempotency key answers the first call's record with already: true. A null value clears it. A refusal is the answer's refused code, never an error.
methods.agent_reason: a plugin's value is set by the buyer at checkout, by the owner on the shop's screens and abilities, or by its own plugin through this door; an assistant writing here would write under no plugin's key

methods.name: value.undo
methods.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Take back one of the calling plugin's value writes: the value it replaced returns. Refused — the answer's refused code — for another plugin's write, one taken back already, or one a later write replaced.
methods.agent_reason: a plugin's value is set by the buyer at checkout, by the owner on the shop's screens and abilities, or by its own plugin through this door; an assistant writing here would write under no plugin's key
